entries.product: EDGAR submissions, filings, and Company Facts/XBRL APIs
entries.point_in_time_policy: Use filing acceptance/known availability; never use report period end as publication time.
entries.revision_policy: Preserve filing accession and amendments as separate dated evidence.
entries.series_selection: Existing SEC ingestion and normalized facts
limitations: Company-reported disclosure; not independent verification.
XBRL coverage varies by filer and tag.

entries.product: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates
entries.point_in_time_policy: Use only an immutable downloaded snapshot observed by the report cutoff; retain Treasury publication date and acquisition timestamp.
entries.revision_policy: Archive each acquired source file by content hash; do not silently replace prior observations.
entries.series_selection: Candidate tenors: 2-year, 10-year, and 30-year; tenor list must be frozen before use.
limitations: Market context, not issuer-specific evidence.
Treasury describes the curve as derived from market quotations; it is not a directly traded yield for every tenor.

entries.product: CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted
entries.point_in_time_policy: Join by BLS release timestamp, not reference month; include only data released by report cutoff.
entries.revision_policy: Archive source response and acquisition timestamp; preserve any later corrections as new snapshots.
entries.series_selection: Frozen national headline CPI-U candidate; no other geography or sub-index unless separately declared.
limitations: Broad consumer-price context; not a company cost or sales measure.
May not capture the input basket relevant to an individual issuer.

entries.product: Producer Price Index, Final Demand, not seasonally adjusted
entries.point_in_time_policy: Join by BLS release timestamp, not reference month; include only data released by report cutoff.
entries.revision_policy: Archive source response and acquisition timestamp; preserve any later corrections as new snapshots.
entries.series_selection: Frozen broad final-demand PPI candidate. Sector-specific PPI series require separate documented mapping.
limitations: Broad producer-price context; not a company-specific realized input cost.
Do not describe as issuer revenue or margin evidence.

entries.product: GDP by industry and industry economic accounts via BEA API
entries.point_in_time_policy: Use BEA release timestamp and archived vintage; exclude data released after report cutoff.
entries.revision_policy: Store vintage/release identifier and raw response hash; later annual or comprehensive revisions create new vintages.
entries.series_selection: Industry/NAICS mapping and exact BEA table/line identifiers must be predeclared per cohort industry before ingestion.
limitations: Industry aggregates are not issuer-specific.
Annual series may be too slow-moving for short-horizon events.

entries.product: Petroleum spot-price time series via EIA Open Data API
entries.point_in_time_policy: Use the source publication/release time where documented; otherwise use the archived acquisition timestamp as a conservative availability bound.
entries.revision_policy: Archive each API response with query, acquisition time, and hash; do not backfill later revisions into earlier report snapshots.
entries.series_selection: Select crude benchmarks and relevant refined-product prices by explicit EIA route/series ID before use; do not choose series dynamically from ticker alone.
limitations: Commodity benchmarks are sector context, not company realized prices or margins.
Business mix and hedging can make benchmark movements a poor proxy for issuer exposure.

entries.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; series data may originate from other agencies
entries.point_in_time_policy: Use ALFRED vintage dates for historical as-known data; retain the original source agency and source release metadata.
entries.revision_policy: Model each vintage as a new observation state; never treat today's FRED history as historically known values.
entries.series_selection: A delivery layer for individually registered series, not a blanket source or publisher attribution.
limitations: FRED is a distributor for many series; cite the originating agency.
A vintage date is not necessarily the exact intraday publication time.

entries.point_in_time_policy: Include auditor/engagement-participant information only from Form AP records public by report cutoff.
entries.revision_policy: Preserve filing and amendment identifiers where available; archive source download and hash.
entries.series_selection: Auditor identity and reported audit participants only.
limitations: Auditor identity or partner changes are not an audit-quality score.
Interpret only alongside audit opinions, inspection findings, and company disclosures.

entries.product: OFR Financial Stress Index and current monitoring tools
entries.point_in_time_policy: Use only current, published indicators with their stated release time and source snapshot.
entries.revision_policy: Record methodology/version and source hash; never substitute a revised index history in a historical as-of report.
entries.series_selection: Use current OFR series only; verify status and methodology at acquisition time.
limitations: System-wide context, not issuer-level evidence.
OFR discontinued its Financial System Vulnerabilities Monitor after Q4 2019; do not treat it as a current feed.

entries.product: FDIC BankFind Suite bank and institution data
entries.point_in_time_policy: Match insured institution identity carefully and use only data released by report cutoff.
entries.revision_policy: Archive query, response, release date, and hash; preserve later corrections separately.
entries.series_selection: Only add after mapping the public issuer to regulated bank subsidiaries and selecting exact fields.
limitations: Consolidated public-company results and insured-bank subsidiary results may differ.
Do not apply to non-bank issuers.

entries.publisher: U.S. General Services Administration / participating agencies
entries.point_in_time_policy: Do not ingest from the catalog as a source of record; follow each dataset to its originating agency and document that agency's release policy.
entries.revision_policy: Dataset-specific; must be resolved at source onboarding.
limitations: Catalog listing does not guarantee original-source status, completeness, update cadence, or historical vintages.
